text: Which objection charges that a belief system could be perfectly coherent yet comprehensively false and severed from reality, so that coherence alone cannot connect justification to truth?
explanation: The isolation objection says coherence cuts belief off from the world: an internally consistent fiction could be maximally coherent yet false. The alternative-systems objection is a different worry, that many mutually incompatible systems are each internally coherent; the generality problem and the Myth of the Given target reliabilism and foundationalism respectively.
